messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PDR-90827 triggered: "model-catalog-config-mismatch" for service=redwood-inference-api - see https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PDR-90827 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Auto-escalation: page to eng-oncall at 1939123460 (priority: high)
alex: acked — jumping in. seeing increased 5xxs from route r-infer/summarize-v1 around 2023-11-08T18:30Z. can someone paste logs?
mira: pasting relevant logs:
```
2023-11-08T18:29:52Z ERROR router request_id=abc123 route=r-infer/summarize-v1 model=redwood/opt-3b:latest rev=57 tokenizer=hf/gpt2 mismatch=true error="tokenizer vocabulary mismatch: expected 50257 got 50260"
2023-11-08T18:30:01Z WARN runtime host=gpu-8 pool=dedicated-3 model_variant=redwood/opt-3b:rev-57 kvcache-miss=true
```
leo: that tokenizer mismatch string matches a recent catalog promotion — rev 57 was promoted last night. looks like the tokenizer package on the serving side is still pinned to hf/gpt2 v1.2, but the promoted rev expects hf/gpt2 v1.3 (vocab shift).
sophia: customer impact: Support triaged ~14 user reports (majority using summarization pipeline) — some saw garbled tokens, others got 500s. no data exfil suspected.
alex: mitigation options: 1) rollback catalog default for redwood/opt-3b to rev-56; 2) update serving tokenizer to v1.3 across dedicated pools (slower); 3) route traffic for alias r-infer/summarize-v1 to compatibility variant rev-55/56. prefer low-risk quick rollback + temporary route override.
mira: agreed. rolling back catalog default now. command: `catalogctl set-default redwood/opt-3b --rev 56 --reason "rollback: tokenizer mismatch on rev 57"`
ops-bot: catalogctl: request accepted. default for redwood/opt-3b set to rev 56 (txn id tx-77f3).
leo: applying route override for r-infer/summarize-v1 to pin to rev-56 for 30m: `routectl override r-infer/summarize-v1 --model redwood/opt-3b:rev-56 --expires 30m`
ops-bot: route override applied. old traffic will drain off once proxies refresh.
sophia: pinging Support: notify affected customers? We should send a short note: "We had a model config regression causing errors; we've reverted to previous model revision and are monitoring."
alex: agreed. also opening an incident in the tracker and tagging customer success for outreach. Incident ref: INC-2023-1108-01 (high).
mira: monitoring dashboards: error rate dropping from 12% -> 2% over 5 minutes. latency unchanged.
leo: followup: schedule to reconcile tokenizer package on serving images overnight. I'll open a PR to bump hf/gpt2 to v1.3 and bake images. we should not rely on model promotions that require tokenizer shifts without a compatibility check.
sophia: creating followup tasks: 1) Add catalog promotion preflight to verify tokenizer compatibility; 2) Add canary traffic gating for rev promotions to critical aliases; 3) Postmortem owner + timeline.
alex: handoff: i'm on for another 30 mins then passing to night oncall. leaving notes in the incident doc. if error rate creeps >5% repage pagerduty.
mira: +1 on handoff. will watch through the window.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PDR-90827 auto-resolved at 1939130200 (status: acknowledged -> resolved) :white_check_mark:
alex: closing notes: root cause = promoted model revision (rev-57) depended on updated tokenizer vocab; catalog promotion didn't run the tokenizer compatibility preflight; mitigation = rollback to rev-56 + route override; next steps = bake serving images with tokenizer v1.3, add preflight, enforce canary gating. thanks team. :tada:
sophia: assigning postmortem to mira. i'll coordinate customer comms with CS.
mira: creating postmortem draft now and will link to INC-2023-1108-01. handoff complete.
